ℹ A SKU counts as out of stock on any day Available (total_quantity) = 0. Consecutive OOS days group into one incident; a later recurrence is a new incident, not a merge. Events
Promotional event performance & strategy
Event Strategy
Amazon Prime Day
June 23 – 26, 2026
20%OFF
Promotional Strategy
Full catalog · Prime Exclusive Discount
Phase 01Lead Up
Prepare
01
Listings & SEO
Refresh listing content, images, and A+ Content to ensure maximum search visibility and conversion readiness before traffic surges.
02
Advertising
Gradually increase budgets 1.5–3x and bids 10%+ in the 7–14 days prior to warm the algorithm and activate event-specific campaigns.
03
Promotions & Pricing
Finalize Prime Exclusive Discounts and confirm all deals are submitted, eligible, and approved with sufficient lead time.
04
Inventory & Operations
Confirm FBA stock coverage, inbound timelines, and buffer inventory levels to prevent sell-outs during peak demand.
05
Creative & Storefront
Upload refreshed imagery and add promotional banners and curated storefront landing pages optimized for high-traffic event conditions.
06
Content Health Check
Resolve any listing suppressions, Q&A gaps, and negative review flags before traffic surges — a suppressed listing during Prime Day is a direct missed opportunity.
Phase 02During
Execute
01
Real-Time Ad Optimization
Increase budgets 2–4x and bids 20%+ as CPCs rise. Reallocate spend to top performers in real time across all ad placements.
02
Deal & Buy Box Monitoring
Ensure all discounts are active and the Buy Box is stable. Resolve any pricing issues immediately — lost Buy Box is direct lost revenue.
03
Listing & Inventory Health
Monitor for suppressed listings and low-inventory alerts in real time to prevent conversion interruptions across the event window.
04
Performance Tracking
Watch sessions, conversion rate, ACOS, and sell-through velocity continuously. Make decisions from live data, not post-event analysis.
Phase 03Lead Out
Capitalize
01
Retargeting & Display
Run Sponsored Display ads to re-engage shoppers who viewed but didn't convert during the event window.
02
Listing Refinement
Update keywords and creatives using what actually converted during the event — real data is the best optimization input.
03
Brand Halo Expansion
Capitalize on new-to-brand traffic with cross-sell and complementary product campaigns to increase basket size.
04
Inventory Replenishment
Adjust restock strategies based on post-event velocity and new customer acquisition rates.
05
Review Acceleration
Activate follow-up sequences to drive organic review growth from event purchasers — the highest-quality acquisition window of the year.
06
Comprehensive Reporting
Deliver clear post-event analysis — what worked, what didn't, and how to capitalize on gains for the next event cycle.

ℹ Ad Spend/Ad Sales/Impressions/Clicks from Amazon Ads. Total Sales/Orders are organic + ads combined (excludes cancelled/pending + Vine). ACOS/TACOS/CTR/CPC/AOV are recomputed from the summed totals, not averaged from each channel's own percentage — averaging percentages directly would be mathematically wrong. CVR is intentionally omitted — the ad summary sheet has an orders/purchases column, only ad units, so there's no real conversion-rate denominator to compute from a proxy would be misleading.
